author: Zephyr I
title: Single-step LN-ConvLSTM + Dilated CNN (d=4) + AdamW+clip — BASE_SEED=60608
abstract: Replicate strong dilated-CNN results with our LN-gated ConvLSTM single-step agent: d=4 backbone, AdamW+clip optimizer. Matches compute budget and settings; BASE_SEED=60608 for direct comparability.
